title: Lazy-MOSAIC: Accelerating Skill-Centric Manipulation Planning with Learned Skill-Effect World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21517v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon manipulation tasks require a robot to perform a sequence of physical interactions with its environment, typically combining several different skills. Planning such behaviors efficiently is challenging: given a library of parameterized skills, solutions lie in a vast hybrid space of skill sequences and their parameters, and evaluating each candidate skill's feasibility and effect with a high-fidelity world model such as a physics simulator is computationally expensive. MOSAIC, a recent skill-centric approach, lets the skills guide a non-sequential search toward the regions of this space where they are likely to succeed; however, it pays the full cost of simulation for every parameterized skill it considers. In this work, we introduce Lazy-MOSAIC, a lazy planning framework that instead searches over hypothesized skill outcomes. translated_title: Lazy-MOSAIC：基于学习的技能效果世界模型加速以技能为中心的操作规划
translated_abstract: 长时程操作任务要求机器人与环境执行一系列物理交互，通常需要组合多种不同的技能。高效规划此类行为极具挑战性：给定一个参数化技能库，解决方案存在于由技能序列及其参数构成的庞大混合空间中，而使用物理模拟器等高保真世界模型来评估每个候选技能的可行性和效果在计算上代价高昂。MOSAIC 是近期提出的一种以技能为中心的方法，它让技能引导一种非顺序搜索，朝向该空间中技能可能成功的区域；然而，它对其考虑的每一个参数化技能都要支付完整的模拟成本。在这项工作中，我们提出了 Lazy-MOSAIC，一种惰性规划框架，它转而在假设的技能结果上进行搜索。一个廉价的学习型技能效果世界模型能够在不到一毫秒的时间内预测技能的可行性与效果。
tldr: Lazy-MOSAIC 通过引入一个廉价的学习型技能效果世界模型，在亚毫秒级时间内预测技能的可行性与效果，从而避免对每个候选技能进行昂贵的物理仿真，显著加速了长时程机器人操作任务的技能中心式规划。
en_tdlr: Lazy-MOSAIC accelerates skill-centric manipulation planning by using a cheap learned skill-effect world model to predict skill feasibility and outcomes in sub-millisecond time, avoiding the costly full physics simulation for every candidate skill.
